content_sections.heading: About ICSIL
content_sections.text: Intelligent Communication Systems India Ltd. (ICSIL) has its office at the Administrative Building, 1st Floor, Above Post Office, Okhla Industrial Estate, Phase-III, New Delhi-110020. It hires staff on a contractual outsourced basis for client departments. Candidates selected under this notice will be deployed at the Delhi Judicial Academy.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Room Attendant and Supervisor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Supervisor (preference): Preference goes to candidates with a graduation in Hotel/Hospitality Management, or with 5 (five) years or more of experience in a supervisory role in the hotel/hospitality industry. The details you give in the application form must match your Class 10th certificate, PAN Card and Aadhar Card. If you changed your name after Class 10th, bring proof of the change to the interaction and document verification. See the official notification for the full eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Every candidate pays a One Time Registration (OTR) fee of Rs. 590/- on the ICSIL website. The fee is non-refundable. ICSIL asks applicants to pay it one day before the walk-in interview and will not be responsible if a late payment is not received or updated in time.

rows.date: One day before the walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: ICSIL checks your documents for age, qualification, experience and other criteria. Interaction/interview with the department for the candidates found eligible. Depending on the post, selection may also include a personal interview, a skill test or a written test. The decision of the interview panel or committee is final and binding. Attending the walk-in does not guarantee selection, and ICSIL does not guarantee that every shortlisted candidate will be deployed.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is purely contractual/outsourced. It lasts for a fixed period, until the contract ends, or until regular staff join the posts. The contract is valid initially up to 28 December 2026. The job does not give any claim to a regular appointment. Selected candidates will be engaged under a specific project or scheme as the department requires, and statutory compliances will apply. You can be deployed anywhere in Delhi/NCR and may work in shifts or on a rotational basis. ICSIL pays no extra conveyance. Fifteen (15) days' salary is deducted as security: 50% in the first month and 50% in the second. It is refunded with savings bank interest after the client department issues a No Dues certificate and you complete your contractual obligations with ICSIL under the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSIL Room Attendant and Supervisor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register online on the ICSIL website . Pay the OTR fee of Rs. 590/- one day before the walk-in interview. Print the proof of fee payment from your "manage profile" page. Go to the Delhi Judicial Academy, Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078, on 31 October 2026 between 10:00 AM and 12:00 Noon. What to bring: The printed proof of OTR fee payment (mandatory) Original documents for date of birth, qualification and experience. You will not be allowed into the interview without them. 1 set of photocopies of all relevant documents 2 photographs Proof of a name change, if your name differs from your Class 10th certificate

faq.question: Q1. Where is the ICSIL walk-in interview for Room Attendant and Supervisor?
faq.answer: The interview is at the Delhi Judicial Academy, Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078, on 31 October 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon.

faq.question: Q2. Can I attend the walk-in without registering online?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates who have registered on the ICSIL website and paid the Rs. 590/- OTR fee will be allowed in. You must also bring a printout of the payment proof from your manage profile.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of an ICSIL Room Attendant?
faq.answer: A Room Attendant gets Rs. 18456/- per month, which is the minimum wage set by GNCT of Delhi. A Supervisor gets Rs. 24356/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification do I need for the Room Attendant post?
faq.answer: You need Matriculation and at least 01 year of experience, and you must be 21-35 years old.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets preference for the Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Graduates in Hotel/Hospitality Management, or candidates with 5 or more years of supervisory experience in the hotel/hospitality industry.

faq.question: Q6. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Both posts work in shifts, either 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM or 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract is valid initially up to 28 December 2026. It is purely contractual and gives no claim to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Will any amount be deducted from the salary?
faq.answer: Yes. Fifteen days' salary is held as security, half in the first month and half in the second. It is refunded with savings bank interest once the client department issues a No Dues certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must match my application form?
faq.answer: Your details must match your Class 10th certificate, PAN Card and Aadhar Card. If you changed your name after Class 10th, bring proof of the change.
